text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: high request rate detected for org sequoia-corp. Paging @emma-oncall and @sre-mike. Severity P1. Dashboard: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1767778888

emma-oncall: On it. Org qps is ~5x baseline, error rate climbing to ~6%. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/sequoia

sre-mike: I see p95 latency spikes and a stream of 429s originating from the per-org limiter. Can we lift the per-org qps for sequoia temporarily? @infra-ops-lee can you advise?

infra-ops-lee: We can apply a tactical override to the token-bucket limiter for sequoia. Recommend +150 qps (50 -> 200) and enable soft backfill so we don't flood shared pools. Rolling now, ETA ~60s.

infra-ops-lee: Command executed: ```curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/orgs/sequoia-corp/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"qps_override":200,"duration_minutes":30}'```
Applied -> override_id=ovr-176777. Monitor metrics and 429s.

support-julie: Customer eng on call: they pushed a frontend feature at 10:12 UTC that increased parallelism/batch size. They've paused the rollout and are reverting now.

customer-sequoia-eng: Confirmed — paused rollout and started revert (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-17-45). ETA ~8m to fully rollback.

emma-oncall: Also enabling traffic-shaping to protect critical paths: deprioritizing non-essential routes and throttling bulk endpoints. Applying route weight 0.3 for non-critical routes.

platform-alyssa: I'm enabling sticky routing to dedicated pool "dedicated-sequoia" to isolate noisy traffic. Routing policy: 80% -> dedicated-sequoia, 20% -> shared-hosts. Should reduce collateral impact.

sre-mike: Metrics update (3m after override): p50 latency down ~25%, 429s down ~80%. Looks stable. Suggest keep override for 20m to let revert complete then do staged rollback.

infra-ops-lee: Got it. Extending override duration by +40min to give burn-in time for revert. Patch: ```PATCH /admin/override/ovr-176777 {"duration_minutes":70}``` — applied.

emma-oncall: Noted. Julie please confirm final customer status and we'll record mitigation steps + RCA owners. I'll create the incident doc after we verify stable window. :white_check_mark:

support-julie: Sequoia confirms revert complete. Traffic trending back to baseline over last 5m. They agree with rollback plan and want a postmortem (focus: rate limit visibility and deploy gating).

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: override ovr-176777 removed at 1767779005. Summary: peak qps ~5.8x baseline, mitigation avoided customer outage. Follow-ups: schedule postmortem with sequoia, add deploy gating alert, improve per-org rate limit telemetry. Pager cleared.
